Finished in Mediterranean Blue, keep toilet paper within easy reach without giving up wall space—this freestanding Euro style toilet paper stand is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and designed for everyday bathroom use, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stays put—a heavy base helps prevent tipping for a more stable floor stand
  • Match a classic look—traditional design pairs with classic bath accessories
  • Choose your finish—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Why solid brass? Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives for lasting bathroom hardware.

Part of the Carolina collection—complete your bathroom with matching pieces for a coordinated, timeless look.

Specs
- Product type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand (Euro style)
- Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
- Style: Traditional
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 x 27 x 6 in
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included items: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
variants.meta_description: 29-inch freestanding toilet paper stand with Euro-style hook and heavy base. Solid brass, traditional style, multiple finishes, limited lifetime warranty.

finish_keywords: mediterranean blue bathroom toilet paper stand
